results.title: Russia proposes carbon credits framework for SMRs
results.content: An international methodology to allow small modular reactors to qualify for carbon credits under the terms of the Paris Agreement has been proposed to the UN's climate/COP secretariat by Russia's state nuclear corporation Rosatom.

results.title: Industry urges nuclear recognition in COP31's 35-by-35 pledge
results.content: The role that nuclear can play in achieving the COP31 summit's pledge to increase electricity to 35% of energy demand by 2035 should be acknowledged, industry leaders have said, with nuclear construction at a 40-year high.

results.title: Energy crisis reinforces comeback of nuclear power, says IEA
results.content: Unprecedented disruption in the energy world - primarily resulting from the war in the Middle East - is set to reinforce the comeback of nuclear power, according to the International Energy Agency's latest World Energy Outlook , which has revised its forecast for nuclear upwards.

results.title: Concrete work completed for Akkuyu 4's turbine unit
results.content: More than 2,240 cubic metres of concrete was used to complete the turbine building foundation for Turkey's Akkuyu Nuclear Power Plant's fourth unit.

results.title: Estonia narrows search for nuclear power plant location
results.content: The search for a site for Estonia's first nuclear power plant will now focus on three locations, all in the municipality of Viru-Nigula, about 120 kilometres east of Tallin, after three locations in Lüganuse municipality were ruled out for security reasons.

results.title: Fourth Hualong One under construction at San'ao site
results.content: The first concrete has been poured for the nuclear island of unit 4 of the San'ao nuclear power plant in China's Zhejiang province, China General Nuclear has announced.

results.title: Strength and leak tests completed for Akkuyu 1 containment
results.content: The air pressure was increased during pre-launch tests, which lasted eight days, to check the strength and leak tightness of the internal containment building for Akkuyu nuclear power plant's first unit.

results.title: OPG set to revise timeline and cost of first SMR unit
results.content: The first of four BWRX-300 small modular reactors under construction at the Darlington New Nuclear Project will not be completed within the previously planned timeline or cost, Ontario Power Generation has said.

results.title: Dome installed at Pakistan's Chashma unit 5
results.content: The inner safety dome has been installed on the containment building of unit 5 at the Chashma nuclear power plant site in Pakistan.

results.title: Mochovce 4's power increased to 35%
results.content: The power output of the fourth unit at Slovakia's Mochovce Nuclear Power Plant has been increased to 35% as the new reactor continues its commissioning process.

results.title: First steam generator installed at Lufeng unit 1
results.content: The first of two steam generators has been installed at unit 1 of the Lufeng nuclear power plant in China's Guangdong province, China Nuclear Industry 23 Construction Company Limited has announced.

results.title: AtkinsRéalis producing study for six-unit Candu plant in Turkey
results.content: AtkinsRéalis's Candu Energy Inc and state-owned Türkiye Nükleer Enerji Anonim Şirketi have signed a memorandum of agreement which includes a feasibility study for a potential 4.5 GW plant featuring up to six Candu reactors.

results.title: Akkuyu 1 fuel loading 'could start next month'
results.content: Turkey's first nuclear power unit is preparing for hot tests - with Rosatom hoping that successful completion will allow the start of nuclear fuel loading in December.

results.title: Work programme being planned for next year, as Paks II audit continues
results.content: Construction is continuing and a programme for next year is being prepared, Rosatom said, as Hungary's government continues its review of the Paks II nuclear power project.

results.title: Low electricity prices could impact EPR2 programme funding, auditor warns
results.content: EDF could face difficulties funding its planned construction of six EPR2 reactors, France's state audit office, the Cour des Comptes (Court of Auditors) has said.

results.title: New York names contenders for next step of nuclear programme
results.content: The New York Power Authority announced the names of the ten nuclear energy developers it has qualified to go forward in its process to select potential partners for its effort to develop at least 1 GWe of advanced nuclear power capacity in Upstate New York.

results.title: Bangladesh's Rooppur 1 supplies country's first nuclear energy
results.content: Rooppur 1, Bangladesh's first nuclear power plant unit, has been connected to the country's grid and supplied its first electricity.

results.title: Maritime nuclear project awarded Norwegian public funds
results.content: The Research Council of Norway has awarded NOK20 million (USD2 million) in initial funding to the Marine Nuclear Propulsion System project as it prepares to move maritime nuclear propulsion from system development towards physical integration and testing.

results.title: Prototype aseismic bearing completed for Rolls-Royce SMR
results.content: Construction company Skanska has completed an aseismic bearing pedestal demonstrator for Rolls-Royce SMR. These structural isolation devices are a key part of the factory-built nuclear power plant's design.

results.title: New nuclear projects offer economic advantages for Ontario
results.content: Four major nuclear projects could bring billions of dollars of economic benefits to Ontario and to Canada - but government and industry need to act now to turn the nuclear buildout into a lasting industrial advantage, according to a report from the national body representing Canada's manufacturing sector.

results.title: Bulgaria's NEK signs MoU for potential BWRX-300 projects
results.content: State-owned electricity company Natsionalna Elektricheska Kompania has signed a memorandum of understanding with Poland's SGE and Blue Bird Energy to cooperate on the deployment of BWRX-300 small modular reactors in Bulgaria.

results.title: Hot and cold testing under way for Turkey's Akkuyu 1
results.content: The first nuclear power reactor in Turkey has moved a step closer to start-up, with hot and cold commissioning tests taking place.

results.title: Samsung, Tesser to collaborate on nuclear-powered LNG carrier
results.content: South Korean shipbuilder Samsung Heavy Industries and US nuclear technology company Tesser Atomics have entered into an exclusive strategic collaboration on a demonstration project for a transatlantic nuclear-powered liquefied natural gas carrier.

results.title: South Africa moving ahead on new nuclear plans
results.content: Energy Minister Kgosientsho Ramokgopa has said his department is preparing to put the case for an additional 5.2 GW of nuclear capacity in South Africa "before the public and will consider submissions on their merits".

results.title: Partners prepare to procure next batch of equipment for Polish plant
results.content: Polskie Elektrownie Jądrowe has signed a letter of intent with the Westinghouse-Bechtel consortium concerning the extension of the scope of the Engineering Development Agreement to cover activities related to the procurement of long lead items for the initial unit of Poland's planned first nuclear power plant.

results.title: ASNR opens passive safety system testing facility
results.content: France's nuclear safety regulator has inaugurated new research infrastructure and facilities at its Cadarache site for studying the reliability of passive safety systems. It aims to generate the scientific knowledge necessary for the independent safety assessment of innovative reactors and small modular reactors.

results.title: Cernavodă units returning to operation after three months
results.content: Nuclearelectrica and the Romanian government are working on long-term solutions to avoid a repeat of the Cernavodă units being shut down because of drought causing abnormally low water levels in the Danube.

results.title: US issues landmark construction permit for Texas SMR plant
results.content: The US Nuclear Regulatory Commission has issued a construction permit for the proposed plant featuring four Xe-100 small modular reactor units at Dow's Seadrift site - the first construction permit for a high-temperature gas-cooled reactor issued in the USA in nearly 60 years.

results.title: IAEA reviews Jordan's nuclear regulatory framework
results.content: Jordan has a "well-established regulatory framework for nuclear and radiation safety", an International Atomic Energy Agency mission has said, while also suggesting further enhancements in line with international safety standards.

results.title: US test reactor cleared for operations
results.content: Oklo's Groves Isotope Test Reactor has been cleared for unrestricted operations by the US Department of Energy.
